## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally (lint, typecheck, test, build)
- [ ] `pnpm format:check` passes
- [ ] Changes to `@uploadcn/core`, `@uploadcn/react` or `@uploadcn/server` include a changeset (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] New or changed registry items: `registry.json`, an example and a docs page are updated, and `pnpm registry:build` was run
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or API changed
